title: 第3章 躺下就移交工作第4章 抽一下风光大办
slug: 共梦后被顶级凶兽们亲哭了
lines: 会这么巧吗？
苏芽芽当然不会觉得这个贵宾就是梦里的那个男人。
她又不是疯了。
那只是一个梦而已，怎么可能呢？
她也不敢抬头，只是把头低得更深些，尽量缩小自己的存在感，生怕惹贵宾不高兴，自己再挨副经理的打。
“什么时候？”贵宾简单几个字，意思是这个半兽人什么时候上场。
阿乌副经理回答：“药效需要两天，正好饿了两天，明天晚上就能上场了，先生要不要先去看看今天晚上的压轴？”
“好。”贵宾闷声回了一声，“走吧。”
苏芽芽的头皮越听越紧。
这位贵宾的声音跟梦里的那个男人的声音简直能有八九成相似了。
她使劲摇摇头，绝无可能。
“0179，”0164果然抱着她的背包回来了，压低声音在角落里喊苏芽芽，“今天的饭，明天再多做两份，这是钱。”
“我不能再做这么多了！”苏芽芽紧张地看着四周。
确定没人，才敢说话。
她比划了个大小：“我的锅就这么大，我哪有功夫给你们做这么多份！”
“不想做也得做，不做就挨打吧你！”0164冲她扬起拳头，“别给脸不要脸！”
苏芽芽不敢得罪人，但是也在末世混迹了一年，也不是一点也不敢为自己争取：“你敢打，我就躺着，这个半兽人就归你看！”
这里的规矩没有那么完善，来这里打工的也都不是什么高素质的兽人，互相打斗很正常。
所以为了确保日常工作顺利进行。
不成文的规定就有一条：只要把别人打伤了，那么别人的工作就落在伤人者头上。
0164看了一眼笼子里的半兽人，脸色都难看了几分。
苏芽芽个头小，一推就倒，是个完全不会打架的主，他一拳确实能放倒苏芽芽。
可按照这个规矩，他就得来看管新来的半兽人，他还想好好活着呢，可不想死这。
“算你他妈走运！”0164只得恶狠狠地骂一句，把另外两份钱拿出来。
“你的我也不做！”苏芽芽把他的那份也扔出来，以后别想吃她做的饭！
“你！”0164气得直瞪眼睛，刚要伸手揍她。
苏芽芽就直接坐地上，随时准备给0164“移交工作”。
“0164，死哪去了！”丁管事嚎了一嗓子，吓得0164赶紧跑路。
苏芽芽从地上爬起来，拍拍身上的土。
她人怂，但志不短。
要是0164好声好气跟她商量，她也很乐于挣点外快。
斗兽场的工资低，各方面克扣高，她巴不得多挣点，好给以后的生活做准备。
但是态度这么差，那就别想了！
那边传来0164的惨叫，夹杂着丁管事呵斥的辱骂声。
苏芽芽听到这个动静就觉得幻痛。
她清楚0164为什么挨打，因为贵宾到场，负责清洁的所有人必须提起脑袋来干活，而0164擅自离岗，被丁管事抓个正着，这等于撞枪口上。
苏芽芽不敢再听，使劲屏蔽自己的耳朵，环视了一圈，这一片空地在她或者笼子中的半兽人死之前，都会是她工作的地方。
其实从今天接手半兽人开始两天内，她没什么别的可干的，只需要饿这个半兽人两天就行。
但是她绝对不能让管事们在监控看到她在这闲着，什么都不干。
她干脆把周围的破烂们收拾一顿，连地面都开着清扫机来回整了两遍。
content_en:
Could it be such a coincidence?
Of course Su Yaya would not think that this distinguished guest was the man in her dream.
It's not like she's crazy.
It was just a dream, how could it be possible?
She didn't dare to raise her head, but lowered her head deeper, trying to minimize her presence, for fear of upsetting the VIP and getting beaten by the deputy manager again.
"When?" The VIP simply said, "When will this orc come on stage?"
Deputy Manager Awu replied: "It will take two days for the medicine to take effect. I have been hungry for two days. I will be able to play tomorrow night. Sir, do you want to go and see the finale tonight?"
"Okay." The distinguished guest replied in a muffled voice, "Let's go."
Su Yaya's scalp became tighter and tighter.
The voice of this distinguished guest was almost 80% to 90% similar to the voice of the man in the dream.
She shook her head vigorously, it was absolutely impossible.
"0179," 0164 came back holding her backpack and called Su Yaya in a low voice in the corner, "For today's meal, make two more portions tomorrow. This is money."
"I can't do so much anymore!" Su Yaya looked around nervously.
Dare to speak only if there is no one around.
She gestured with the size: "My pot is only this big, how can I have the time to make so many servings for you!"
"You have to do it even if you don't want to do it. If you don't do it, you'll get beaten!" 0164 raised his fist at her, "Don't be shameless!"
Su Yaya didn't dare to offend anyone, but she had been living in the apocalypse for a year, so she didn't dare to fight for herself at all: "If you dare to fight, I will just lie down, and this orc will be yours to look after!"
The rules here are not that perfect, and the people who work here are not high-quality orcs. It is normal to fight with each other.
So to make sure the day-to-day work goes smoothly.
There is an unwritten rule: as long as someone is injured, the other person's work falls on the person who injured them.
0164 glanced at the orc in the cage, and his face looked a little ugly.
Su Yaya is small and can be knocked down with a push. He is a master who doesn't know how to fight. He can really knock Su Yaya down with one punch.
But according to this rule, he had to take care of the new orcs. He still wanted to live well, but he didn't want to die.
"You're damn lucky!" 0164 could only curse fiercely and take out the other two pieces of money.
"I won't cook yours either!" Su Yaya threw out his portion too. Don't even think about eating her cooking in the future!
"You!" 0164 glared angrily and was about to reach out and hit her.
Su Yaya just sat on the ground, ready to "hand over the work" to 0164 at any time.
"0164, where did he die!" Manager Ding howled, causing 0164 to run away in fright.
Su Yaya got up from the ground and patted the soil on her body.
She is timid, but has great ambition.
If 0164 talks to her in a nice voice, she will be happy to earn some extra money.
The wages at the Colosseum were low and deductions were high in all aspects. She was eager to earn more so that she could prepare for her future life.
But if your attitude is so bad, don’t even think about it!
The screams of 0164 came from over there, mixed with the yelling and insults from Manager Ding.
Su Yaya felt phantom pain when she heard this movement.
She knew why 0164 was beaten. Because VIPs were present, everyone responsible for cleaning had to raise their heads to work. However, 0164 left his post without permission and was caught by Manager Ding. This was tantamount to hitting the muzzle.
Su Yaya didn't dare to listen anymore. She shielded her ears and looked around. This empty space would be her place of work before she or the orc in the cage died.
In fact, in the two days since she took over the orc today, she has nothing else to do. She only needs to starve the orc for two days.
But she absolutely couldn't let the supervisors see her idle here, doing nothing.
She simply cleaned up the rags around her and even drove the sweeper back and forth to tidy the ground twice.
title_en: Chapter 3: Hand over the work as soon as you lie down Chapter 4: Take advantage of the situation
